author: Screen Junkies
description: Hey, gang! Get hyped! We're stoked to welcome back a classic series. Stop by the Screen Junkies channel on Monday, February 23rd to see Dan Murrell, Mike Carlson and Spencer Gilbert duke it out in a not-so-serious competition! It's a heavy-dose of nostalgia that, let's face it, we could all use to escape the real world a little more.
title: Screen Junkies Movie Fights Returns!
